newsitem.title: USA: Aon votes dividend hike, 3-for-2 split.
newsitem.headline: Aon votes dividend hike, 3-for-2 split.

text.p: Aon Corp said Friday it increased its quarterly cash dividend to $0.39 per share from $0.36, payable May 14 to holders of record on May 1.

The insurance services holding company also said its board approved a three-for-two stock split, payable in the form of a stock dividend of one common share for every two shares held. The dividend will be payable May 14 to holders of record on May 1.
The increased cash dividend payable May 14 will be paid on pre-split common shares. The quarterly cash dividend rate, as adjusted for the split, would be $0.26 per share.
